description: RETIRED S441: a bare `@count = 5` write at the §40.8 body-top is ordinary logic — no E-WRITE-NOT-IN-LOGIC-CONTEXT, and the write runs (the display reads 5).
rationale: ⛑ S441 RE-AUTHORED — a `<program>` / `<page>` / `<channel>` body carries no loose prose (§40.8 S441 bullet; ruling user-voice-scrml.md S441 "prose should be declared as such" + "declared-prose implementation: yes to all four"). Ruled item 4: "E-WRITE-NOT-IN-LOGIC-CONTEXT is RETIRED for <program>/<page>/<channel> bodies (the body is logic now)". The case id is kept so the history of the S123 rule stays findable. Pre-S441 rationale: §40.8 S123 amendment (the S122 user-voice Option-2 ratification): "default-logic mode auto-lifts DECLARATIONS only — the structural state-decl form `<name> = expr` … The bare V5-strict reactive WRITE form `@name = expr` is NOT a declaration — it is a write to a pre-declared cell, and writes ARE logic; logic goes in `${...}`. Bare `@name = expr` at the IMMEDIATE body-top of `<program>` / `<page>` / `<channel>` (the §40.8 default-logic-body surface) SHALL fire `E-WRITE-NOT-IN-LOGIC-CONTEXT`." The §34 row confirms the diagnostic is a SHAPE error, deliberately independent of whether the target cell resolves — so this case declares `<count>` first (V5-strict structural form) to isolate the shape rule from E-STATE-UNDECLARED. §34 also fixes the two legal repairs: (a) wrap in `${ @count = 5 }` (see the NEG mirror), or (b) convert to a structural declaration.
